prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: a synthetic handwriting dataset contact sheet for a Python image feature demonstration.
Create one high-resolution landscape scan, exactly 3 equal-width columns and 6 equal-height rows (18 cells), filling the whole canvas. Each cell contains the same four clearly legible handwritten Traditional Chinese characters, verbatim: 春風明月
The page is flat, clean pure white, with extremely thin light-gray straight separators at exactly one-third and two-thirds of the canvas width and exactly every one-sixth of the canvas height. No outside margins, title, labels, numbers, signatures, logos, paper textures, shadows, ruler or perspective.
Leave generous blank interior margins around every phrase so every phrase stays inside the central 75% of its cell.
Each column represents a fictional handwriting STYLE, not a real person:
Column 1: neat upright regular handwriting, separate square forms, consistent medium black pen strokes.
Column 2: strongly right-slanted flowing semi-cursive handwriting, connected relaxed strokes, elongated forms, same medium black pen weight.
Column 3: angular slightly left-slanted compact handwriting, sharp corners, tall narrow forms, same medium black pen weight.
Write the phrase anew in each of the six rows: preserve the column's style while making small natural changes in stroke shape and spacing. Do NOT duplicate or paste one raster phrase six times. All columns must use identical ink blackness and identical white backgrounds; the differentiating factor should be letterforms, not background or color. Use identical phrase placement and similar overall size in every cell.
The image is fictional sample data, not a document, certificate, real person's writing, or forensic evidence. No labels inside the cells.
